claims.scope: For symmetric A with s_3(A)>=1 and any nonzero physical pivot A_ii, either two complementary physical diagonals have magnitude>=1/2, or the pivot row has an original-coordinate bank of l2 norm>1/(4sqrt(2)), or a physical cross bank disjoint from the pivot has s_1>1/(4sqrt(2)).

For the account02/B20 P1 pivot |A_ii|>=3501/8000, the two-complementary-diagonal branch is paid unless all three physical diagonals have the same sign and all three mutual cross entries have magnitude>3501/16000. Mixed signs give density<92.928; a same-sign pair with cross <=3501/16000 gives density<8.290.

Every unresolved account02/B20 P1 packet reduces to coherent same-sign triangle, strong physical star with row norm>1/(4sqrt(2)) and source-valid marginal projection cap<8, or strong disjoint physical cross bank with s_1>1/(4sqrt(2)).
